links.outcome: Performance degradation of foundation model embeddings across scanners and field strengths
links.effect: Acquisition signatures such as hardware differences are captured in embeddings and degrade performance on external data; FEATMAP reduces performance gaps without retraining. No numbers reported in the abstract.
links.quote: However, successful model deployment is hampered by performance degradation on external data.

unlisted_practices: Embedding-level harmonization with a global affine transformation fitted on paired data to correct acquisition signatures without retraining

screen.reason: Evaluates a post-hoc embedding harmonization technique (FEATMAP) to correct acquisition signatures and mitigate performance degradation across different scanners/sites without retraining the underlying foundation models.
